people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.
translations.bsb: So Israel set up an ambush around Gibeah.
translations.kjv: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
translations.asv: And Israel set liers-in-wait against Gibeah round about.
